# PTC Scores a Major Security and Digital Transformation Win with Zero Trust

> Zscaler supports a “café-style” work-from-anywhere model by completely eliminating VPN to provide a superior user experience and improve security posture

**Customer Name:** PTC

### Key Metrics
- **100%**: transformation to a zero trust architecture
- **↓ CapEx**: by turning off aging equipment
- **Reduced**: infected machines

## Metadata

- **Language:** en

## Customer Snapshot
- **Title:** PTC
- **Description:** Software and services provider for all phases of product life cycle management across multiple sectors
- **Industry:** High Tech
- **Headquarters:** Boston, Massachusetts, USA
- **Size:** 7,000+ employees across 30 countries

## Executive Summary
### Challenges
- Legacy VPN enabled threat actors by exposing internal IP addresses, allowing lateral threat movement across the network
- Increased adoption of cloud services and SaaS necessitated a policy-based approach to connect and secure apps, identities, and devices
- Fragmented and limited visibility into network issues resulted in excessive time spent on troubleshooting and diagnosis

### Results & Impact
- Enables work from anywhere with a café-like experience, offering least-privileged access to resources without putting users on the network
- Reduces the attack surface by replacing vulnerable infrastructure and blocking threats regardless of user location or device
- Saves money by reducing upgrades and maintenance of an aging cybersecurity physical infrastructure

## Featured Quotes
> "One of the things that happens when you get Zscaler in place, both ZIA and ZPA in our case, is that you really reduce the attack surface."
> — **Matt Hart — CISO — PTC**

> "We see zero trust as a really good set of guiding principles for how we can approach our safety."
> — **Matt Hart — CISO — PTC**

> "With ZPA, we're able to go to our branches and start to turn off aging equipment that we are about to spend a ton of capex on to replace."
> — **Matt Hart — CISO — PTC**

> "Zscaler is a set of products that truly make zero trust something that you can rely on to keep your company safe from harm."
> — **Matt Hart — CISO — PTC**
